Monaco Cancels Chelsea's Lamine Camara Transfer Amid Liverpool Involvement

Monaco has cancelled the transfer of Lamine Camara to Chelsea, reportedly due to a call from Liverpool. Chelsea is described as furious over the last-minute collapse of the deal, which was valued at approximately £47 million. Monaco's chief reportedly made an "extraordinary accusation" related to the cancellation. There are also reports of a phone call between Xabi Alonso and Lamine Camara.
